ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Teamerge to use the camera for QR code scanning.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Teamerge connects to the desktop app on your LAN.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Teamerge to use your microphone for voice dictation sent to your paired desktop for transcription.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow Teamerge to save images from your sessions to Photos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Teamerge to attach photos from your library to a terminal session on your paired desktop.
